observations.name: CyberX 26 CTF — Read Between the Bytes

facts.location: RNS Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, India
facts.eligibility: Inter-college competition; organizer-associated RNSIT Department of Cyber Security material specifies B.E./B.Tech, MCA & MBA students.
facts.format: 8-hour in-person CTF with RECON, EXPLOIT, and ZERO HOUR rounds; cryptography is a published category.
facts.prize_evidence: INR 30,000 total cash: INR 15,000 first, INR 10,000 second, INR 5,000 third.
facts.authorization_boundary: Competition activity is limited to organizer-issued platform, challenges, and the isolated vulnerable-machine environment under current rules. Public RNSIT systems, websites, networks, repositories, sponsor systems, or third parties are not testing targets.

missing_verification: Exact registration deadline/capacity and participant-specific acceptance state.

Complete governing rules, including AI/tool policy, prohibited techniques, tie-breaking, technical-failure handling, and disqualification conditions; the organizer page exposes these headings but the bounded retrieval did not expose all answers.
Whether the Devpost generic geographic/age eligibility language is controlling or subordinate to the organizer's inter-college/student eligibility.
Prize payment/tax terms and any conditions attached to goodies/vouchers.
Travel/lodging responsibility for participants attending the Bengaluru venue.
observations.deduplication: No CyberX 26 item was identified in the inspected current-main state or open research PR titles/bodies. Treat this as contributed research until canonical chronology reaches Sep. 26 afternoon.
observations.recommended_next_action: When chronologically eligible, reopen the organizer registration/rules surface and Devpost rules, resolve eligibility/deadline/tool-policy conflicts, and create a structured competition case only if participation is intended and eligible.

notes: This file preserves contributed research only and does not advance data/source_check_history.json or data/intelligence_sources.json.
